summary: The skew-adjointness transport machinery (lines 138–181, plus the quadratic composition at 194–210) is a verbatim copy of TypeD.lean modulo `JD`→`JB` and the basis name, so a reusable general fact is hidden inside two private scripts; and the Gram-matrix proof adds a globally simp-tagged lemma in reverse orientation inside the same simp call.
